Bachelor of Engineering (Chemical Engineering Co-Operative Program)

1st & 2nd Semester

1st SEMESTER
Common to: Aerospace, Biomedical, Chemical, Civil, Computer, Electrical, Industrial, and Mechanical Engineering

REQUIRED:
Introduction to Engineering
* Writing Skills
General Chemistry
Calculus I
Linear Algebra
Physics: Mechanics
LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table A .

* This course is graded on a pass/fail basis.

2nd SEMESTER

REQUIRED:
Chemical Engineering Fundamentals
General Chemistry Laboratory
Digital Computation and Programming
Principles of Engineering Economics
Calculus II
Physics: Waves and Fields

3rd & 4th Semester

3rd SEMESTER

REQUIRED:
Thermodynamics I
Fluid Mechanics
Organic Chemistry
Electric Circuits
Differential Equations and Vector Calculus

NOTE: All required courses in 1st and 2nd semesters are prerequisites to all required courses in 3rd semester.

4th SEMESTER

REQUIRED:
Thermodynamics II
Process Measurements
Heat Transfer
Instrumental Methods of Analysis
Communication in the Engineering Professions

5th & 6th Semester

REQUIRED:
Chemical Engineering Materials
Mass Transfer
Introductory Bioengineering
Engineering Statistical Design
Chemical Engineering Computations

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table A .

7th & 8th Semester

7th SEMESTER

REQUIRED:
* Plant Design
Chemical Engineering Equipment Design
Unit Operations Laboratory II
Process Control

PROFESSIONAL: Two courses from Table I .

* A multi-term course.
8th SEMESTER
REQUIRED:
Law and Ethics in Engineering Practice
* Plant Design

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table B .

PROFESSIONAL: Three courses from Table I .

* A multi-term course.
